verdict.rationale: Jan's own docs say it connects with Claude Code and OpenClaw. It also exposes an Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages endpoint so Anthropic clients can point at local models. So the product documents pairing third-party coding agents with its local models, but there is no evidence of a single-command, pre-configured launcher. Missing for 10: a documented single-command launch of agent CLIs, automatic pre-configuration to local models, coverage of multiple popular coding agents, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch popular third-party coding agent CLIs pre-configured to use my local models with a single command

citations.quote: Connect Jan with Claude Code, OpenClaw, MCP servers, and more.
Anthropic-compatible messages endpoint. Jan automatically translates requests to the internal format, so you can use Anthropic SDK clients pointed at your local server
